_comment: Approximate, rounded literature values for educational use only. Concentrations are plasma concentrations; mg/L equals ug/mL. dose_conversion converts mg of the administered dose to the amount unit of the concentration (1.0 for mg->mg; lithium carbonate -> mmol Li+). t_half_h, F and vd_l_per_kg describe a 70 kg adult with normal renal function; vd_l_per_kg and ka_per_h are fitted so that AUC/steady-state level, Cmax and Tmax match published data (see reference_pk.json). cv_cl / cv_f: inter-individual CV of clearance / bioavailability (log-normal). elimination.pathways: fraction of clearance carried by each pathway (CYP/UGT/CES1 enzyme name, 'renal' for unchanged urinary excretion, or another non-CYP route); the unassigned remainder is unaffected by genotype. Only encoded where a label mass balance or concordant in-vivo data supports it - drugs without it behave as before. fe_renal is the 'renal' entry and both spellings stay in sync. metabolite: one active metabolite formed from the parent's clearance; 'reported' says whether the preset's concentrations and window mean the parent, the metabolite, or their potency-weighted sum. verified on a protein_binding, elimination or metabolite block: as in reference_pk.json - true only once checked against the primary document named in its source. protein_binding.fu: unbound fraction, recorded for reference only - every therapeutic range here is a total plasma concentration (AGNP 2017 consensus: its ranges refer to the total fraction and, unless a row says otherwise, to trough levels; methylphenidate's are Cmax-based), so no prediction depends on fu. saturable: Michaelis-Menten km (concentration unit) and the saturable share of low-concentration clearance. two_compartment: central volume as a fraction of vd_l and inter-compartmental clearance Q (L/h, 70 kg). tlag_h: oral absorption lag. formulations: selectable product forms (e.g. prolonged release) overriding bioavailability, ka_per_h, tlag_h and the default regimen; the first entry is the default. enzyme_inactivation: mechanism-based inactivation of the enzyme carrying 'fraction' of clearance (kinact 1/h, KI in the concentration unit, kdeg = enzyme turnover 1/h); t_half_h is then the half-life once the enzyme is inactivated. t_half_range_h is the published half-life range (used for the band only when cv_cl is missing).

protein_binding.note: MPA Brufen PAR: 'protein binding being approximately 99.5 %' (fu 0.005) but also 'mean free fraction is approximately 1% in healthy subjects'. Evans 1989 (abstract) measured 0.42 % (R) and 0.64 % (S) unbound. Binding is nonlinear and stereoselective (Evans 1989, Paliwal 1993).

drugs.name: Paracetamol (acetaminophen)

protein_binding.note: Morris & Levy 1984 (abstract): about 20 % bound in healthy adults after 1.5 g. US label: 10-25 % at therapeutic levels. The previously cited PMC3654056 is a mouse adduct study.

elimination.note: Critchley 1986 (Br J Clin Pharmacol 22:649) Table 2, 111 healthy Caucasians, 1.5 g Panadol fasted, % of 24 h urinary recovery: glucuronide 53.8, sulphate 31.2, mercapturic acid 5.0 + cysteine 4.3 (CYP2E1), unconjugated 5.7. Replaces 0.5/0.4/0.05/0.05, attributed to a label that does not contain it. The oxidative share rises in overdose, which this model does not cover.

drugs.notes: MTC is a conservative modelling threshold; hepatotoxicity risk is dose- and time-dependent (acute overdose is assessed with the Rumack-Matthew nomogram).

drugs.name: Amoxicillin

protein_binding.note: US AMOXIL label: 'Approximately 20% protein-bound'. Czech SPC: 'Asi 18 %'.

elimination.note: Czech SPC (Duomox) 5.2: renal excretion 50-85 % over 24 h (midpoint 0.675); IV urinary recovery 68 % (Humbert 1979, abstract). The '60 % to 80 %' sentence previously quoted is from extended-release labels. Oral urinary recovery falls with dose because absorption saturates (Chulavatnatol 1994); the renal share of systemic clearance does not.

drugs.notes: Time-dependent killing: efficacy tracks time above the pathogen MIC. MEC here is an illustrative MIC for susceptible organisms; the upper limit is an arbitrary educational reference (wide therapeutic index).

drugs.name: Lithium (carbonate)

protein_binding.note: Plasma protein binding is negligible (US label; Czech SPC; NZ data sheet).

elimination.note: NZ data sheet: renal excretion '>95% of the dose' (a floor; faeces <1 %). Not metabolised; about 80 % of filtered lithium is reabsorbed in the proximal tubule, which is why sodium and volume depletion raise levels.

drugs.dose_basis: mg lithium carbonate (1 mg = 0.02707 mmol Li+)
drugs.notes: Maintenance window 0.6-1.2 mmol/L (trough, 12 h post-dose); toxicity above 1.5 mmol/L. The MTC used for the red zone is 1.5; levels of 1.2-1.5 are flagged as the upper edge of the window.

drugs.name: Diazepam

metabolite.name: Nordazepam (N-desmethyldiazepam)
metabolite.note: N-desmethyldiazepam (nordazepam). Formation fraction 0.53 is OBSERVED: 'Based on area analysis, the extent of conversion of DZ to systemic DMDZ averaged 53%' (Greenblatt 1988, IV diazepam and IV DMDZ in the same 11 subjects, mean age 62; abstract only). It replaces 0.761, which was calibrated. Half-life 65 h and Vd 1.24 L/kg: Ochs 1982 (abstract, IV clorazepate, n=17). molar_ratio = 284.74/270.72. The steady-state ratio 1.26 (Greenblatt 1981, 110 outpatients, mean of individual ratios; ratio of means 1.18) is no longer reproduced: see tests/test_drug_database.py. potency_ratio 1.0 is an unsourced placeholder and inert while reported='parent' (in-vitro rat binding gives 0.85, not an in-vivo potency). Not verified for that reason.

protein_binding.note: Allen & Greenblatt 1981 (abstract, n=62): free fraction 1.48 %. Czech SPC and US Valium label: 98 % bound (fu 0.02). Klotz 1975: 97.4 % (fu 0.026). The free fraction rises with age.

elimination.note: No primary states the fractions. CYP2C19 0.5 is derivable from phenotype data: poor metabolisers clear half as fast (Andersson 1990; Bertilsson 1989: half-life 88 vs 41 h); Czech SPC esomeprazole AUC +80 %. Asian cohorts give 0.45-0.86. CYP3A4 0.4 has no in-vivo support; an in-vitro study gives 3-hydroxylation 90 % of metabolism at one concentration (Zomorodi 1996).

drugs.notes: Nordazepam, the active metabolite (t1/2 about 65 h), is simulated as a second curve; the reported concentration and the therapeutic window remain those of diazepam itself.

drugs.name: Livizux (lisdexamfetamin)
drugs.dose_basis: mg lisdexamfetamin dimesilát (Livizux), 1 mg LDX ≈ 0.294 mg d-amfetaminu
drugs.notes: Lisdexamfetamin dimesilát (Livizux). Proléčivo aktivního d-amfetaminu na ADHD. Užívá se 1× denně ráno. Enzymatická hydrolýza v krvi zajišťuje pozvolný nástup (Tmax cca 3.5–4 h) a trvání účinku 12–14 h. AGNP terapeutické rozmezí d-amfetaminu 20–80 ng/mL (0.02–0.08 µg/mL).

drugs.name: Levetiracetam (Keppra)

protein_binding.note: US label, EU SmPC and Czech SPC: under 10 % bound, so fu is at least 0.9.

elimination.note: US label: 'renal excretion as unchanged drug which represents 66% of administered dose'; the carboxylic acid ucb L057 is 24 %, formed by serine esterase hydrolysis, not CYP (EPAR). F is 100 %, so fraction of dose equals fraction of clearance. Corrects an earlier fe_renal of 0.75.

drugs.notes: Levetiracetam (Keppra). Téměř 100% perorální biologická dostupnost. Terapeutické monitorování dle AGNP doporučení 12–46 µg/mL.

drugs.name: Pregabalin

protein_binding.note: US Lyrica label, EPAR and Czech SPC: does not bind to plasma proteins.

elimination.note: US label: 'approximately 90% of the administered dose was recovered in the urine as unchanged pregabalin'; EPAR: renal clearance 88 % of total. Corrects an earlier 0.98, which was the percentage of urinary radioactivity. Under 2 % appears as metabolites.

drugs.notes: Vysoká biologická dostupnost (≥ 90 %), lineární kinetika, minimální vazba na bílkoviny plazmy. Terapeutické rozmezí dle AGNP 2.0–5.0 µg/mL, toxicita > 8.0 µg/mL.

drugs.name: Propranolol

protein_binding.note: Inderal label: approximately 90 % bound to albumin and alpha-1-acid glycoprotein, enantiomer-selective; AGP-driven and variable. Hemangiol SmPC: about 90 %.

drugs.notes: Neselektivní lipofilní beta-blokátor. Výrazný jaterní first-pass efekt (F ≈ 25 %, mezi pacienty silně kolísá – CV expozice cca 50 %). Zdánlivý distribuční objem 2.7 L/kg je nafitován na publikované Cmax/AUC po 40–80 mg (IV hodnota cca 4 L/kg). Terapeutické rozmezí 20–100 ng/mL (0.02–0.10 µg/mL), toxicita > 0.20 µg/mL. Forma s prodlouženým uvolňováním (Inderal LA a obdoby): pomalé vstřebávání (Tmax cca 6 h) a nižší expozice, ustálená AUC odpovídá cca 60–65 % stejné denní dávky v dělených dávkách běžné formy.

drugs.name: Rivotril (clonazepam)

protein_binding.note: US Klonopin label: approximately 85 % bound. Czech SPC: 82-86 %.

drugs.notes: Klonazepam (Rivotril). Dlouhý poločas rozpadu (30–40 h), silná akumulace v ustáleném stavu. Terapeutické rozmezí dle AGNP 20–70 ng/mL (0.02–0.07 µg/mL), toxicita > 0.08 µg/mL.

drugs.name: Mirtazapin

elimination.note: Störmer 2000 (DMD 28:1168, abstract; full text unreachable), in vitro at 2 uM: 8-hydroxylation 55 % of metabolism, CYP2D6 65 % and CYP1A2 30 % of it; N-oxidation 10 %, CYP1A2 80 % of it. CYP2D6 = 0.55 x 0.65 = 0.36; CYP1A2 = 0.55 x 0.30 + 0.10 x 0.80 = 0.245 (was 0.19). CYP3A4 0.35 is not verifiable: the abstract gives N-demethylation by CYP3A4 only as '>50%' below 1 uM, so it lies between about 0.2 and 0.37. The CYP2D6 share falls with concentration. The back-test reproduces carbamazepine and ketoconazole within 1.30x and 1.01x.

protein_binding.note: Remeron label: approximately 85 % bound over 0.01-10 ug/mL. Czech SPC: about 85 %.

drugs.notes: Noradrenergní a specifické serotonergní antidepresivum (NaSSA). Dávkování jednou denně večer. Zdánlivý distribuční objem (10.5 L/kg) je nafitován na ustálené hladiny pacientů (medián cca 37 ng/mL při 30 mg/den); jednokompartmentový model proto podhodnocuje vrchol po první dávce. AGNP terapeutické rozmezí 30–80 ng/mL (0.03–0.08 µg/mL), toxické hladiny > 0.15 µg/mL.

drugs.name: Risperidon

elimination.note: Parent risperidone is CYP2D6-dominant: 1 - 12.9/65.4 = 0.80 from the CATIE population clearances in extensive and poor metabolisers (Feng 2008 Table 3; the intermediate 36 L/h was fixed). The stored 0.78 did not follow from those numbers. Assumes no residual activity in the PM class, which holds 41 % of subjects and only partly reflects genotype. The ACTIVE MOIETY is nevertheless CYP2D6-independent (label), because less 9-OH forms but the parent clears more slowly.

metabolite.name: 9-hydroxyrisperidon (paliperidon)
metabolite.note: 9-hydroxyrisperidone (paliperidone). Simulated separately and reported as the sum, the active moiety the AGNP 20-60 ng/mL range refers to. Formation fraction = the parent's CYP2D6 fraction (0.80, corrected with it). Half-lives 3 h (parent) and 21 h (9-OH) are US label values for extensive metabolisers; the Czech SPC gives 24 h for 9-OH. Volumes are solved, not observed: the joint solve used a 9-OH:parent AUC ratio of 'about 5', but the primaries give 6 (Huang 1993, oral, EM, mean of ratios), 6.36 (FDA NDA 21-999 BEL-28, median 6.61), ratio of mean AUCs 4.09. Structural limitation: 9-OH is formed only from systemic parent, but the observed ratio is 3 after IV and 6 after oral dosing, so first-pass formation is real and not modelled.

protein_binding.note: Risperdal label and Czech SPC: risperidone 90 % bound, 9-hydroxyrisperidone 77 % (Health Canada: 88 %; measured median 16 % unbound in young healthy subjects). The free fraction rises about 35 % in hepatic impairment.

drugs.notes: Atypické antipsychotikum. Risperidon a jeho metabolit 9-hydroxyrisperidon jsou modelovány zvlášť; vykazovanou veličinou zůstává jejich součet (aktivní frakce), ke kterému se vztahuje terapeutické okno. AGNP terapeutické rozmezí 20–60 ng/mL (0.02–0.06 µg/mL), riziko EPS > 0.08 µg/mL. Variabilita mezi pacienty (cv_cl 1.08) je odvozena z publikovaného cca 20násobného rozpětí ustálených hladin aktivní frakce (1,8–36,8 nmol/l na mg/den): odpovídá log-SD 0,91, z čehož genotyp CYP2D6 vysvětluje jen 0,23, tedy asi 6 % rozptylu; zbytek je variabilita v rámci fenotypu.

drugs.name: Kvetiapin

elimination.note: Derived, not stated by any source. Grimm 2006 (Br J Clin Pharmacol 61:58) Table 4: ketoconazole 200 mg once daily for 4 days, single 25 mg quetiapine, 12 healthy men, AUC x6.22 (US label Table 17: 6.2-fold, CL/F -84 %; Czech SPC 4.5: 5-8-fold). fm = (1 - 1/6.22) / (1 - r) = 0.86, with r = 0.024, the ketoconazole residual CYP3A4 activity derived in data/enzymes.json from oral midazolam. Both victim and index were oral, so fm includes gut-wall CYP3A4 and overstates the purely hepatic share. In vitro (same paper): CYP3A4 forms the sulfoxide and the N- and O-desalkyl metabolites; CYP2D6 only the minor 7-hydroxylation. Because fm comes from the ketoconazole study, the measured ketoconazole row in interactions.json is not an independent check of it. Carbamazepine (measured 0.13) is under-predicted by this fm: the mechanism gives about 0.30 with the registry's carbamazepine.

metabolite.name: Norkvetiapin (N-desalkylkvetiapin)
metabolite.note: N-desalkylquetiapine (norquetiapine), the active metabolite that carries the NET inhibition and most of the muscarinic affinity. Half-life 12 h: Seroquel XR label 12.3 and Czech SPC 5.2. Calibrated, not observed: no study gives its formation fraction or volume, and the two are not separable from plasma data. Volume set equal to the parent's (an assumption); formation fraction solved so the steady-state AUC ratio norquetiapine/quetiapine is 0.51, the midpoint of the label's 46-56 % (XR label 12.3, divided IR doses up to 800 mg/day). molar_ratio = 383.51/295.40 (quetiapine base C21H25N3O2S / norquetiapine C17H17N3S). Check: the model's steady-state Cmax ratio is 0.35 (mass) against the label's 21-27 %, because the one-compartment parent peaks too low (see notes); against the observed parent peak it is about 0.20. Reported quantity stays the parent: 'quetiapine activity is primarily due to the parent drug' (US label 12.3) and the AGNP range refers to quetiapine. potency_ratio 1.0 is a placeholder, inert while reported='parent'. Norquetiapine is itself formed and cleared by CYP3A4 (Czech SPC 5.2); the engine forms it from total parent clearance, so its curve does not respond correctly to CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers.

protein_binding.note: US Seroquel label 12.3 Distribution: '83% bound to plasma proteins at therapeutic concentrations'. Czech SPC 5.2: approximately 83 %.

drugs.notes: Atypické antipsychotikum (antagonista 5-HT2A a D2, silný antagonista H1 a alfa-1). Norkvetiapin, aktivní metabolit (t½ cca 12 h), je simulován jako druhá křivka; vykazovaná koncentrace a terapeutické okno se týkají samotného kvetiapinu. Poločas 7 h (SPC 5.2), zdánlivý distribuční objem 9,4 l/kg (štítek USA: 10 ± 4 l/kg) a F = 1 (absolutní biologická dostupnost není v primárních zdrojích uvedena, proto jsou V a CL zdánlivé, V/F a CL/F). CL/F 65 l/h odpovídá ustálenému stavu u pacientů (Grimm 2006, 300 mg 2× denně, AUCτ 4650 ng·h/ml); zdraví dobrovolníci po jednorázové dávce 25 mg mají CL/F 138 l/h, takže jejich AUC model přeceňuje cca 2×. Jednokompartmentový model podhodnocuje vrcholy v ustáleném stavu zhruba na polovinu (300 mg 2× denně: model 0,58, naměřeno 1,04 µg/ml), průměr a údolní hladiny sedí. Forma s prodlouženým uvolňováním: Tmax cca 6 h (SPC, štítek USA), stejná AUC jako IR. Variabilita cv_cl 0.33 je interindividuální CV clearance z populační farmakokinetiky (Fukushi 2020, 322 pacientů, abstrakt). Terapeutické okno: AGNP 2017 terapeutické referenční rozmezí 100–500 ng/ml (údolní hladina), laboratorní varovná hladina 1000 ng/ml = MTC; tyto hodnoty nebyly ověřeny proti plnému textu konsenzu (nedostupný), jeden sekundární zdroj uvádí dolní mez 150 ng/ml.

drugs.name: Ritalin (methylfenidát)

protein_binding.note: US Ritalin label and Czech SPC: 10-33 % bound (fu 0.67-0.90, midpoint 0.785).

elimination.note: US Concerta label: ritalinic acid about 80 % of the dose (Ritalin label and Czech SPC: 60-86 %); unchanged under 1 % (a ceiling). Hydrolysis by CES1 (Sun 2004); no CYP involvement. Stereoselective for l-methylphenidate, which is why d-methylphenidate dominates in plasma.

drugs.notes: Methylfenidát-hydrochlorid (Ritalin). Krátkodobě působící stimulans CNS indikované při ADHD a narkolepsii. Rychlá absorpce (Tmax 1–2 h), nízká perorální biologická dostupnost racemátu (F ≈ 15 %; d-MPH 22 %, l-MPH 5 %) vlivem first-pass metabolismu. Krátký biologický poločas eliminace (t½ cca 2–3 h) vyžaduje podávání 2–3× denně (interval 6–8 h, obvykle ráno a v poledne). AGNP doporučené terapeutické rozmezí 5–20 ng/mL (0.005–0.020 µg/mL), nežádoucí a toxické hladiny > 0.030 µg/mL.

drugs.name: MDMA (ecstasy)

enzyme_inactivation.note: kdeg = ln2 / 46.6 h, the CYP2D6 recovery half-life of O'Mathuna 2008 (J Clin Psychopharmacol 28:523, abstract only; 15 men, 1.5 mg/kg oral, dextromethorphan probe, recovery by about 10 days). An independent study from the same group gives faster recovery: Yubero-Lahoz 2011 (Clin Pharmacokinet 50:319, PMID 21456632, abstract only) found 36.6 +- 22.9 h in women and 27.6 +- 25.1 h on re-analysis of the male data. 46.6 h is kept because the model was built on it; it sits at the slow end, so the co-medication tab overstates rather than understates how long a CYP2D6 substrate stays raised after MDMA. Both studies agree on near-complete inactivation: the dextromethorphan metabolic ratio rose 60- to 100-fold and most to all subjects phenocopied poor metabolisers. kinact and KI are not measured values: they were fitted to MDMA's own repeated-dose PK (second dose about +66 % AUC at 24 h, Farre 2004/2015); in vitro values from the same group span about 100-fold between expression systems. Hence verified=false.

drugs.notes: MDMA (3,4-methylendioxymetamfetamin). Nástup účinku perorálně 30–60 min (Tmax cca 2 h), nosně 5–15 min. Nelineární kinetika: MDMA nevratně inaktivuje vlastní enzym CYP2D6 (obnova trvá cca 10 dní, poločas obnovy cca 47 h). Druhá dávka proto zvýší hladinu výrazně víc než prostý součet: o cca 17 % při odstupu 2–4 h a AUC druhé dávky o cca 65–77 % i po 24 h. t½ cca 11 h platí po inaktivaci enzymu, tj. po každé běžné dávce. Riziko hypertermie a hyponatrémie; doporučeno nekombinovat s jinými stimulancii a inhibitory MAO/SSRI.

drugs.name: Ketamin

protein_binding.note: Dayton 1983 (abstract only): 'bound as much as 47% to human plasma', pH-dependent, conditions not stated. Hijazi 2002: 60 % in serum at 30 C. Esketamine (Spravato label): 43-45 %. No racemic-ketamine label states binding.

drugs.notes: Ketamin. Výrazný first-pass efekt při perorálním užití (F ≈ 20 %). Nosní aplikace poskytuje F ≈ 50 % s rychlým nástupem (5–10 min). Nekombinovat s tlumivými látkami (alkohol, opioidy, benzodiazepiny).
